title: Weird Food
description:
Weird Food adds different types of food you would not expect in Minecraft. 
Download the mod to see what you can eat!
body:
Weird Food.

A mod that adds different types of food, unexpected types of food, to your Minecraft world.

Foods that are added are:
- Squid Tentacles
- Squid Stew
- Slime Sandwich
and much more.

More items are planned to be added to the mod.
